text: Mrs. Elara's aphids are STILL crawling free while everyone just talks about them — Reed brings up the peach pie a THIRD time and gets shredded again by Dusk and Flint, who think string and dessert won't fix bugs. Vale actually starts digging into real pest-control research and even name-drops a pipe that broke in Sector Gamma, turning it into a whole speech about how nobody fixes problems before they explode. Lumen's "let's all go look together" plan is still just floating out there, ignored. Dusk, meanwhile, is spinning the broken pipe into some deep metaphor about everyone ignoring warning signs — still hasn't touched an aphid.
